tasks.title: Once grants end to end: every job-run request gets the card; once Allow replays allow_once; fail-closed attach; cancel-only rewrite deleted
tasks.objective: Make every scheduled-job permission request attach to the job card: attachRequest classifies grant rule|once (once = no persistable rule), once rows use request-id identity and carry no atoms, Allow on a once row replays a signed allow_once with no rule write, attach failure denies the tool call with a logged reason (no classic prompt), and the job-only cancel-only option rewrite in ipc-permission-classifier-decision.ts is deleted. Unit coverage in the jobperm suites.
acceptance_criteria: a job-run request with no persistable rule creates a `once` need row and a card revision with Allow / Deny; no classic prompt is sent and the job-only cancel-only option rewrite no longer exists.
Allow on a `once` row replays a signed `allow_once` to the runner, writes no rule, and the held tool call resumes; Deny denies; the card settles and logs delivery as today.
`rule` rows behave exactly as before (rule write + replay); existing rows without a mode read as `rule`.
a job attach failure denies the tool call with a logged plain reason instead of falling through to the chat prompt.

tasks.title: Once expiry settlement + Postgres integration proof of the once chain
tasks.objective: A once row whose run ended before a decision settles as expired with the AC5 copy and never becomes durable authority; Postgres integration proof of the once chain (attach → Allow → signed allow_once replay, no rule written).
acceptance_criteria: a `once` row whose run ended before a decision settles as expired with copy "Expired — the run ended before a decision; it will ask again next run" and never becomes durable authority.
Postgres integration proof: a signed scheduled once-card attach → Allow → `allow_once` replay with no rule written (permission-decision-chain suite).
